commands.commentary: Gate commands are declarative expectations; the linter does not execute them.

migrations.justification: P036 is a Swift UI/navigation and presentation proposal over existing GraphQL read projections and governed approval mutations. It does not add database schema or persistence migrations.

hold_conditions: P036 prep artifact is missing or incomplete.
Field-level projection/detail-read inventory is missing or incomplete for any governed UI surface.
Any Swift UI path reintroduces MCP UI calls, broad GraphQL mutations, local workflow truth, or raw artifact truth fallback.
Ideas exposes executable create, configure, archive, or launch controls inside Swift UI without a future approved write-transport proposal.
Inline approval context fails to preserve P085 actionability, stale, unauthorized, redacted, already-resolved, duplicate, or conflict behavior.

Standalone Approvals tab is removed before equivalent inline approval context, global attention indication, banner routing, keyboard routing, deep-link parity, and parity checklist evidence are verified.
Phase 2.5 dogfood evidence has fewer than five canonical task-set runs or fewer than two operators without an explicit release-manager waiver.
Remote UI smoke/accessibility evidence is unavailable for the consolidated navigation flow before release promotion.
Timeline batching drops terminal, diagnostic, conflict, or completion events, ignores Reduce Motion, or causes unreadable lag.
P036 rollout readback fixture or negative fixtures are missing, unsafe, stale, or fail the rollout contract linter.

steps: Disable consolidated navigation feature flag or restore legacy tab routing while preserving GraphQL thin-client reads.
Keep approval mutations governed by P085/P031 paths; do not restore removed local write controls.
Disable timeline batching/collapse flag if timeline evidence fails while preserving raw projected timeline entries.
Attach failed gate, dogfood, and remote UI evidence to release receipt.
Re-enable only after prep evidence, affordance tests, projection gap handling, dogfood minimum, and remote smoke pass.
